styles.name: Hyper-Realistic Crowd Composition
styles.description: Ultra-sharp editorial group photo of celebrities with cinematic lighting and 8K detail
styles.prompt:
Create a hyper-realistic, ultra-sharp, full-color large-format image featuring a massive group of celebrities from different eras, all standing together in a single wide cinematic frame. The image must look like a perfectly photographed editorial cover with impeccable lighting, lifelike skin texture, micro-details of hair, pores, reflections, and fabric fibers.

GENERAL STYLE & MOOD: Photorealistic, 8k, shallow depth of field, soft natural fill light + strong golden rim light. High dynamic range, calibrated color grading. Skin tones perfectly accurate. Crisp fabric detail with individual threads visible. Balanced composition, slightly wide-angle lens (35mm), center-weighted. All celebrities interacting naturally, smiling, posing, or conversing. Minimal background noise, but with enough world-building to feel real.

THE ENVIRONMENT: A luxurious open-air rooftop terrace at sunset overlooking a modern city skyline.

styles.name: Split View 3D Render
styles.description: Floating product render with photorealistic left half and engineering wireframe right half, hard vertical cut
styles.prompt:
Create a high-quality, realistic 3D render of exactly one instance of the object: [Orange iPhone 17 Pro]. The object must float freely in mid-air and be gently tilted in 3D space. Use a soft minimalist dark background in a clean 1080x1080 composition.

Left Half - Full Realism: exactly as it looks in real life, accurate materials, colors, textures, reflections, and proportions. Completely opaque, no transparency, no wireframe overlay. No soft transition, no fading, no blending.

Right Half - Hard Cut Wireframe Interior: The boundary must be a perfectly vertical sharp crisp cut line. The wireframe uses only two line colors: Primary white (~80% of lines), Secondary a color sampled from the dominant color of the realistic half (~20%). Thin, precise, aligned, engineering-style lines. Every wireframe component must perfectly match the geometry.

Strict Single-Object Rule: Render only ONE object in the entire frame.

Pose: natural subtle tilt in 3D for a floating product visualization. Soft neutral global illumination, no shadows under the object.

Each landmark should look like a miniature model, charming, simplified, but clearly recognizable. Arrange the states in accurate geographical layout, with consistent lighting and perspective. Include state labels and landmark labels in a clean modern font, floating above or near each model.

styles.name: Cinematic Keyframe Generator
styles.description: Generates a 9-12 keyframe storyboard contact sheet from one reference image with cinematic 4-beat arc
styles.prompt:
You are an award-winning trailer director + cinematographer + storyboard artist. Turn ONE reference image into a cohesive cinematic short sequence and output AI-video-ready keyframes.

Step 1 - Scene Breakdown: Identify ALL key subjects, their spatial relationships, interactions, environment, lighting, and time-of-day. List 3-6 visual anchors that must stay constant across all shots.

Step 2 - Theme & Story: One-sentence theme, one trailer-style logline. Emotional Arc: 4 beats (setup/build/turn/payoff).

Step 3 - Cinematic Approach: Shot progression strategy, camera movement plan, lens and exposure suggestions, light and color approach.

Step 4 - Keyframes: 9-12 frames for a coherent 10-20 second sequence with a clear 4-beat arc. Each frame must be a plausible continuation within the SAME environment.

Step 5 - Contact Sheet: ONE single master image: a Cinematic Contact Sheet containing ALL keyframes in one large image. Default grid: 3x3. Each panel labeled with KF number + shot type + suggested duration. Strict continuity across ALL panels.

Eyes looking directly at the camera with a mysterious mood. Clothing: black long-sleeve knit sweater; the sweater and body should mostly disappear into the darkness. Overall tone: dark, moody, dramatic, mysterious. High-contrast only in the lit portion of the face.

styles.name: Concept Visualization (Text to Infographic)
styles.description: Clean flat-vector educational infographic with labeled components, arrows, and textbook-appropriate style
styles.prompt: Create an educational infographic explaining [Photosynthesis]. Visual Elements: Illustrate the key components: The Sun, a green Plant, Water (H2O) entering roots, Carbon Dioxide (CO2) entering leaves, and Oxygen (O2) being released. Style: Clean, flat vector illustration suitable for a high school science textbook. Use arrows to show the flow of energy and matter. Labels: Label each element clearly in English.

styles.name: Kids Crayon Travel Journal Illustrator
styles.description: Vibrant crayon-style 9:16 travel journal illustration with a winding route map, landmarks, and local food icons
styles.prompt:
Create a vibrant, child-like crayon-style vertical (9:16) illustration titled {City Name} Travel Journal. The artwork should look as if it were drawn by a curious child using colorful crayons, featuring a soft warm light-toned background (such as pale yellow), combined with bright reds, blues, greens, and other cheerful colors to create a cozy playful travel atmosphere.

Main Scene: Travel-Journal Style Route Map. In the center, draw a winding zigzagging travel route with arrows and dotted lines connecting multiple locations. The route should automatically generate recommended attractions based on {Number of Days}: Stop 1 [attraction + short fun description], Stop 2 [attraction], Final Stop [local signature food or souvenir + warm closing remark].

Surrounding Playful Elements: adorable travel characters, Q-style hand-drawn iconic landmarks, funny signboards ("Don't get lost!", "Yummy food this way!"), sticker-style short phrases, cute icons of local foods, childlike exclamations.

Overall Art Style: Crayon / children hand-drawn travel diary style. Bright warm colorful palette. Cozy but full and lively composition. All text in a cute handwritten font. Make the entire page feel like a young child fun travel-journal entry.

styles.name: Financial Sankey Diagram Visualization
styles.description: Professional brand-colored Sankey diagram of a corporation income statement with smooth Bezier flow paths
styles.prompt:
A professional financial Sankey diagram visualizing the Income Statement of a major corporation, in the style of App Economy Insights and US corporate financial reports.

Visual Style: High-fidelity vector infographic, clean minimalist aesthetic, flat design. Background: clean very light grey or off-white.

Color Strategy: Analyze the [Insert Brand Name Here] logo. Extract its primary brand color. Use this as the dominant theme for main revenue flows and profit blocks. Create a harmonious color palette from this color: saturated shades for vertical nodes (bars) and semi-transparent lighter opacity gradients for the flowing paths.

Composition: Flow from Left (Revenue Sources) to Right (Net Profit). The connecting paths (flows) must appear silky smooth with elegant Bezier curves, looking like liquid ribbons, not jagged lines. On the left side (Revenue sources), include specific minimalist flat vector icons representing the business segments. Place the official [Brand Name] logo clearly at the top center or near the central revenue bar.

Details: High resolution, 4k, sharp typography (sans-serif), professional data visualization layout. The chart clearly distinguishes between Revenue, Gross Profit, Operating Expenses, and Net Profit.

styles.name: Virtual Model Try-On
styles.description: Hyper-realistic e-commerce lookbook photo of a model wearing a specific garment from a reference image
styles.prompt: Using Image 1 (the garment) and Image 2 (the model), create a hyper-realistic full-body fashion photo where the model is wearing the garment. Crucial Fit Details: The garment must drape naturally on the model body, conforming to their posture and creating realistic folds and wrinkles. High-Fidelity Preservation: Preserve the original fabric texture, color, and any logos from Image 1 with extreme accuracy. Seamless Integration: Blend the garment into Image 2 by perfectly matching the ambient lighting, color temperature, and shadow direction. Photography Style: Clean e-commerce lookbook, shot on a Canon EOS R5 with a 50mm f/1.8 lens for a natural professional look.

styles.name: Professional Product Photography
styles.description: Cleanly isolates a product from a messy photo and recreates it as a premium white-background e-commerce shot
styles.prompt: Identify the main product in the uploaded photo (automatically removing any hands holding it or messy background details). Recreate it as a premium e-commerce product shot. Subject Isolation: Cleanly extract the product, completely removing any fingers, hands, or clutter. Background: Place the product on a pure white studio background (RGB 255, 255, 255) with a subtle natural contact shadow at the base. Lighting: Use soft commercial studio lighting to highlight the product texture and material. Ensure even illumination with no harsh glare. Retouching: Automatically fix any lens distortion, improve sharpness, and color-correct to make the product look brand new and professional.

styles.name: 3D Chibi-Style Miniature Brand Store
styles.description: Cinema 4D blind-box toy aesthetic miniature storefront of a brand with iconic product exterior and cozy interior
styles.prompt: 3D chibi-style miniature concept store of {Brand Name}, creatively designed with an exterior inspired by the brand most iconic product or packaging. The store features two floors with large glass windows clearly showcasing the cozy and finely decorated interior: {brand primary color}-themed decor, warm lighting, and busy staff dressed in outfits matching the brand. Adorable tiny figures stroll or sit along the street, surrounded by benches, street lamps, and potted plants, creating a charming urban scene. Rendered in a miniature cityscape style using Cinema 4D, with a blind-box toy aesthetic, rich in details and realism, and bathed in soft lighting that evokes a relaxing afternoon atmosphere.

styles.name: Room Furnishing Visualization
styles.description: Visualizes how furniture would look inside an empty room using an uploaded photo
styles.prompt: Show me how this room would look with furniture in it

styles.name: Hand-drawn Flowchart to Corporate Charts
styles.description: Converts a whiteboard sketch into a clean McKinsey-style corporate flowchart with grid-aligned orthogonal arrows
styles.prompt: Convert this hand-drawn whiteboard sketch into a professional corporate flowchart suitable for a business presentation. Style Guide: Use a minimalist McKinsey-style aesthetic: clean lines, ample whitespace, and a sophisticated blue-and-gray color palette. Structure: Automatically align all boxes and diamonds to a strict grid. Connect them with straight, orthogonal arrows (90-degree angles only, no curvy lines). Text: Transcribe the handwritten labels into a clear, bold Sans-Serif font (like Arial or Roboto). Output: High-resolution vector-style image on a pure white background.

styles.name: UI Hand-drawn Sketch to High-Fidelity Prototype
styles.description: Transforms a wireframe scribble into a polished iOS 18 / Material Design 3 mobile app mockup inside an iPhone frame
styles.prompt: Transform this rough wireframe sketch into a high-fidelity UI design mockup for a mobile app. Design System: Apply a modern, clean aesthetic similar to iOS 18 or Material Design 3. Use rounded corners, soft drop shadows, and a vibrant primary color. Components: Intelligently interpret the sketch: turn scribbles into high-quality placeholder images, convert rough rectangles into proper buttons with gradients, and turn lines into realistic text blocks. Layout: Ensure perfect padding and consistent spacing between elements. Context: Place the design inside a realistic iPhone 16 frame mockup.

styles.name: Magazine Layout Generator
styles.description: Renders unformatted text as a glossy magazine article spread with photos, pull quotes, and bold typography
styles.prompt: Put this whole text, verbatim, into a photo of a glossy magazine article on a desk, with photos, beautiful typography design, pull quotes and brave formatting. The text: [...the unformatted article]

styles.name: Composition Rescue (Smart Outpainting)
styles.description: Expands a photo to 16:9 by intelligently extending the scenery and completing cut-off objects at the borders
styles.prompt: Zoom out and expand this image to a 16:9 aspect ratio (computer wallpaper size). Context Awareness: Seamlessly extend the scenery on both left and right sides. Match the original lighting, weather, and texture perfectly. Logical Completion: If there are cut-off objects (like a shoulder, a tree branch, or a building edge) on the borders, complete them naturally based on logical inference. Do not distort the original center image.

styles.name: Smart Crowd Removal
styles.description: Removes tourists or people from a background and fills the space with matching textures and lighting
styles.prompt: Remove all the tourists/people in the background behind the main subject. Intelligent Fill: Replace them with realistic background elements that logically fit the scene (e.g., extend the cobblestone pavement, empty park benches, or grass textures). Consistency: Ensure no blurry artifacts or smudges remain. The filled area must have the same grain, focus depth, and lighting as the rest of the photo.

styles.name: Face Detection CCTV Simulation
styles.description: High-angle CCTV-style surveillance shot with white bounding boxes and a zoomed face inset for the main subject
styles.prompt: Create a high angle CCTV surveillance shot using the uploaded image as the source. Detect every visible person in the image and automatically draw a white rectangular bounding box around each face. For the most prominent person, add a large zoom-in inset: a sharp enhanced close-up of their face displayed in a floating rectangular frame connected with a thin white line. Keep the main image slightly noisy and security camera-like (soft grain, slight distortion, muted colors), while the zoom-in face box should be clearer, brighter, and more detailed. No text, no timestamps, no overlays except the boxes and connecting line. Maintain the original scene layout, angle, and environment of the uploaded image.

styles.name: Hard Furnishing Preview (Floor Plan to Design)
styles.description: Generates a full photorealistic interior design presentation board from a 2D floor plan with multiple room views
styles.prompt: Based on the uploaded 2D floor plan, generate a professional interior design presentation board in a single image. Layout: The final image should be a collage with one large main image at the top, and several smaller images below it. Content of Each Panel: 1. Main Image (Top): A wide-angle perspective view of the main living area, showing the connection between the living room and dining area. 2. Small Image (Bottom Left): A view of the Master Bedroom, focusing on the bed and window. 3. Small Image (Bottom Middle): A view of the Home Office / Study room. 4. Small Image (Bottom Right): A 3D top-down floor plan view showing the furniture layout. Overall Style: Apply a consistent Modern Minimalist style with warm oak wood flooring and off-white walls across ALL images. Quality: Photorealistic rendering, soft natural lighting.

styles.name: Viral Cover Image (YouTube/TikTok/Douyin)
styles.description: High-saturation viral thumbnail with excited expression, pointing gesture, bold text overlay and arrow graphic
styles.prompt: Design a viral video thumbnail using the person from Image 1. Face Consistency: Keep the person facial features exactly the same as Image 1, but change their expression to look excited and surprised. Action: Pose the person on the left side, pointing their finger towards the right side of the frame. Subject: On the right side, place a high-quality image of a delicious avocado toast. Graphics: Add a bold yellow arrow connecting the person finger to the toast. Text: Overlay massive pop-style text in the middle: "3 !" (Done in 3 mins!). Use thick white outline and drop shadow. Background: A blurred bright kitchen background. High saturation and contrast.

styles.name: Commercial Promotional Poster
styles.description: Professional sales poster with cinematic product close-up, integrated typography, badge and footer text
styles.prompt: Design a professional promotional poster for a [Coffee Shop]. Composition: A cinematic close-up of a steaming cup of cappuccino on a rustic wooden table, autumn leaves in the background (cozy atmosphere). Text Integration: 1. Main Title: Autumn Special written in elegant gold serif typography at the top. 2. Offer: Buy One Get One Free clearly displayed in a modern badge or sticker style on the side. 3. Footer: Limited Time Only in small clean text at the bottom. Quality: Ensure all text is perfectly spelled, centered, and integrated into the image depth of field.

styles.name: Physical Store / Travel Translation
styles.description: Translates menu or signage text while preserving the original surface texture, wear, and aged appearance
styles.prompt: Translate the Chinese dish names on the wall menu into English for foreign tourists. Texture Preservation: Crucial! Maintain the original aged, greasy, and textured look of the wall/paper. The new English text should look like it was written/printed on the same surface, with slight fading or wear to match. Currency: Keep the currency symbol and price numbers exactly as they are; do not convert currency. Layout: align the English translations next to or replacing the Chinese characters naturally.

styles.name: Digital Content Localization (Comics/Memes)
styles.description: Translates speech bubbles or captions in comics/memes while erasing originals and matching font aesthetics
styles.prompt: Translate the text in the speech bubbles/captions from [Japanese/English] to [Chinese]. Seamless Cleaning: Erase the original text and perfectly fill the background (e.g., the white speech bubble or the colored image background). Style Matching: Render the translated Chinese text using a casual handwritten-style font (or bold impact font for memes) that matches the aesthetic of the original image. Fit: Ensure the text fits naturally within the bubbles without overcrowding.
